chunks: And from a sermon of his (peace be upon him) which he delivered at Dhi Qar while he was heading towards Basrah; al-Waqidi mentioned it in the book 'Al-Jamal'.

key_terms.الْبَصْرَةِ: Basrah, a major city in Iraq
key_terms.ذِي قَارٍ: Dhi Qar, a location near Basrah

ai.seo_question: Where did Imam Ali deliver the sermon recorded by al-Waqidi in Al-Jamal?
ai.summary: This bibliographical note anchors the sermon in the historical context of the Battle of the Camel, specifically at Dhi Qar, a key staging ground before the confrontation with Aisha, Talhah, and Zubayr. Al-Waqidi’s inclusion in 'Al-Jamal' highlights the event's significance in early Islamic historiography, while the sermon itself serves as a theological and political justification for Imam Ali’s (AS) stance against the rebels.
